source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Extending H&K's proposal to denominal verb formation in Sakha
notes: Apart from external arguments, internal arguments can also be introduced, at most two. One of them will be licensed as dative benefactive, the other one as syntactic accusative KP.
en: Kesha presented Misha with a book.
